clauses.reason: The clause designates the Attorney General and designees as the United States local authorities and competent officers under Article XIII of the Convention with Greece and directs fulfillment of the obligations. 8 CFR 252.5 as held (eCFR through 2026-10-14) applies the designation under E.O. 11300; no amendment, revocation or supersession was found by the bounded searches.

research_rationale:
EO 11300 (31 FR 11009, signed 1966-08-17) designates the Attorney General, and such other officers and employees of the Executive Branch as the Attorney General may specify, as the local authorities and competent officers on the part of the United States within the meaning of Article XIII of the Convention between the United States and Greece (33 Stat. 2122, 2131), and directs them to fulfill the Article XIII obligations in the manner prescribed. The held Federal Register original has no sunset, condition or revocation clause. The held eCFR text of 8 CFR 252.5 (amended through 2026-10-14) states that under E.O. 11300 of August 17, 1966 (31 FR 11009) and 28 CFR 0.110 the Commissioner and immigration officers are designated local authorities and competent officers within the meaning of Article XIII of the Convention with Greece. the bounded machine searches current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr and later-events:ofr_catalog were read for coverage and show no amendment, revocation or supersession. The held sources do not include the text of the Convention or any treaty-status source; no source held shows termination of Article XIII.
